title: Digga le sumaaqitte
intro: Aamanti girat gibbateeh, angoyya sinni kibal ellecabo sadu yekke wakti cubbus. Atu Qur’aanak addal tan xaagitte elle tamixxigeh tan buttah kinnaane wagsiisak, sissin qaynatih gicloh addat tan gicloh addat tan gicloh gicloh gicloh gicloh addat tan buttah kinnaane diggoysaanamih taama lito. too roocitte miyya kinnim kee qaadik tan caaloota keenil garaytem cedoonuh rortitte fak.
clues: Nanu ninni diini cabnuh kaxxa gutqo tanim takkay immay, ninni kibaalal maqarluk soole.
Nanu hadafneh sugne caylale miraacay monotheism diifu bargusam faxa.
Nanu kaxxa astooti kee muqjiza nuble, uxih ni zulmi hangisso sinnim raqte.
Nanu coolaysitneh qangiino le cogda faatacisneh gersi mara qarkakisah xayyossuh.
Nanu girah yan jahannab addat qidneh sugne, takkay immay ni sabhalal Yallih xaqul fayyale arac neh geyte.
Ni aydaadi qaran cutuukak migaqle suuratal qaddooweh yan, mu'miniinit qansarissah tan maritteh sarrimaaneh takkaawisso.

outcome.label: Nek Illacaboh Saami
options: Oson ardi bagul amoytiinu geenih yenen.
oson cakkumuk yan kudah cateenih yenen.
oson martyrdom kee amotani acwa geenih.
Oson mango gadda kee leeda yomcowwe.
outcome.answer: oson martyrdom kee amotani acwa geenih.

arabic: وَمَا نَقَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
verse: And they resented them not except because they believed in Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy, (85:8)
